overview.text: The Faculty of Pharmacy offers the Bachelor of Pharmacy (PharmD, Clinical Pharmacy) program to prepare pharmacists qualified with current pharmaceutical and medical concepts, able to support the healthcare system locally and regionally. Its graduates are meant to work in clinical and industrial pharmacy. The page lists six scientific departments (pharmaceutics; pharmaceutical, analytical and organic chemistry; pharmacognosy and natural products; microbiology and immunology; biochemistry and molecular biology; clinical pharmacy and pharmacy practice), which the page itself marks as provisional pending the Faculty Council's official list.
